title: Fixed Circular Pit and Centre Pivot Turntable
description: One whole original fixed railway turntable appearance: continuous circular pit floor and raised rim, complete circular running ring, central pedestal, complete narrow girder and planked rail bridge, two I-section tracks, end wheels and axles, and one side handrail. The pit is open around the bridge and below its deck rather than a flat decorated disc. No old turnout, train, bench or machine mesh imported. Three opaque constant PBR materials, metres, Z up and horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. One static prop, zero scenes. No rotation, track gauge compatibility, rail alignment, load rating, engineering design, installation, traversability or operating safety claim.
